spoken: Gravity doubles. Weight follows. Every load becomes twice as heavy. Known physics says the mechanism is spacetime curvature and acceleration under general relativity. The best supported consequence is this: orbits, structures and biology would respond to the same changed acceleration. The exact timeline depends on how the impossible change occurs.
